subject: creating a package to add a menu to Deducer

messages.author: a814dd0eade31e3e
messages.subject: creating a package to add a menu to Deducer
parts:
I am planning to use Deducer/R/JGR for my class at UCSD. I have a source file that works (i.e., creates the menu etc.) but I would like to put this in a package that will be automatically loaded when JGR is opened (for both Windows and PC).

I downloaded the source package for DeducerPluginExample but can't install from source (see message [1] below). If I try R CMD check on the source package I get the attached errors. 

Note: I also tried to at a .First function to .Rprofile to source the code but that doesn't work when you just open JGR. I'm working on a Mac.

The Deducer wiki has a section 'Wrapping it up into a package' but this provide enough information to actually make the package. At least not for me :)

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: creating a package to add a menu to Deducer
parts:
Hi Vincent,

As per:
http://www.deducer.org/pmwiki/pmwiki.php?n=Main.BuildingDeducerFromTheSource

On the mac you need to set an environmental variable to install from
source. either do

NOAWT=1 R CMD INSTALL ...

or from within R

Sys.setenv(NOAWT=1)
install.packages(...)


ian
